svg.title: MLA decode roofline on B300 — the per-CTA-corrected (real) prediction landed at the floor (~0% HBM, 0.75 TFLOP/s); the pure-roofline compute-flip did NOT realize on CUDA cores
svg.desc:
A log-log roofline plot for B300 / sm_103. The diagonal is the 8 TB/s HBM bandwidth bound; the flat ceiling is the FP16 tensor-core compute peak (2500 TFLOP/s); they meet at the ridge at arithmetic intensity 312.5 (dashed vertical). Three points mark the AI ladder along the roofline: GQA-8 fp16 decode at AI=8 sits far left, deep in the memory-bound region; MLA fp16 decode rises to AI=234.8, a knife-edge just below the ridge (0.75 times it); MLA nvfp4 decode reaches AI=835, well to the right of the ridge in the compute-bound region.
The two-layer prediction is drawn as two markers. The pure-roofline prediction (a purple star) sits high on the compute ceiling — naively predicting MLA flips compute-bound, the first decode shape in the v1-to-v11 arc to do so on paper. The MEASURED point (a solid blue square) lands at the per-CTA floor far below: achieved throughput 0.75 TFLOP/s, which is about 0.03 percent of the FP16-TC peak and percent-HBM about 0 percent. A dashed vertical gap arrow connects the star down to the square, marking the correction.
Verdict (detail in the figure caption): the per-CTA-corrected layer LANDED — %HBM stayed flat at about 0 percent out to N_k=2M, a working set of 679 MB or 5.1 times the measured 132.6 MB B300 L2, so the per-CTA-bound read is confound-free; 0.75 TFLOP/s achieved on clocks that were idle-pinned, measured counter-free because ncu was blocked (the percent-HBM proxy was validated against ncu once on T4). The pure-roofline compute-flip did NOT realize, because the CUDA-core kernel packs M=128 as 16 blocks times 8 warps of warp-per-head GEMV, not one tensor-core GEMM — so it stays per-CTA / low-MLP latency-bound and runs about 4 times slower than torch dense-MQA at the real 576/512 shape (vs_sdpa about 0.23 to 0.29 times). The shape is correct and tensor-core-friendly (validated structurally); realizing the flip needs tcgen05 (M greater-equal 128) — data-motivated future work, not gating.
svg.text: MLA decode roofline (B300): two-layer prediction vs measured
Pure roofline predicted a compute-flip; the per-CTA-corrected layer landed at the floor.
